source: ICAI section-wise weightage issued 26 October 2023, applicable May 2024 onwards (syllabus/CA foundation question weightage.pdf); ICAI skill-wise weightage (syllabus/CA foundation skill-wise-weightage.pdf); ICAI sample paper May 2025 (syllabus/SA May 2025 QA.pdf).
deviation_note: ICAI permits a maximum deviation of plus or minus 5 percent on the specified section-wise weightage.

skill_levels.note: ICAI classifies Paper 3 as 100 percent Level II (Application); Level I (Comprehension and Knowledge) is unlisted. Generate predominantly application and problem-solving items. The sample paper carries a few definitional items, so a small conceptual minority is faithful to the real paper.

Permutations and Combinations; Sequence and Series; Sets, Relations and Functions, Limits and Continuity; Calculus
Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Odd Man Out; Direction Tests; Seating Arrangements; Blood Relations
sections.weight_note: ICAI lists 20-30 percent for each of the four Logical Reasoning topics.

sections.label: Statistical Representation of Data and Sampling; Measures of Central Tendency and Dispersion

explanation_kinds.note: ADR 0023. Each item carries an explanation_kind (reasoning archetype) that sets what its explanation, explanation_sections.approach, and per_option_rationale must foreground. Resolution order: per-item explanation_kind, then a family override below, then the section default_explanation_kind. Heterogeneous Section III defaults to derivation and is refined per family here.

derived_target_note: derived_target_questions applies the midpoint of each ICAI weightage range to the part's question count and rounds so each part sums to its total. Use as a generation and mock-assembly guide, not a hard ICAI figure; the plus or minus 5 percent deviation applies.
usage: Drives generation volume per family, mock-paper assembly, and readiness weighting. Section percentages are within each part; parts are 40/20/40 marks at one mark per question.
